analysis.insight_summary: A user asks whether there will be a replacement for the discontinued [product_name], specifically if another module is meant to succeed it. Another user clarifies that there is no direct alternative offered, leaving users with no clear path for migration. This discussion underscores the importance of transparent product lifecycle information and alternative solutions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to have an official replacement or migration guide for discontinued modules and more transparent communication from [company_name] regarding product updates and succession.
